title: Illuminated Kidney Grille
summary: Feedback on the G60 grille centers on favorable reactions to the illuminated kidney grille and front-end design, while many other mentions are too brief or context-limited to classify confidently.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the illuminated kidney grille and the look of the new front grille within the overall exterior design.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined mentions include brief references to the grille and context-limited remarks about design preference, peeling, plastic material, and trim damage that cannot be cleanly summarized as a single sentiment pattern.

limitations: Most sampled mentions are undetermined, so clear sentiment evidence is limited.
Several fragments are very short or truncated, which restricts reliable interpretation.
The undetermined cluster mixes appearance references, material comments, damage mentions, and a durability-related note rather than one coherent subtopic.
